{{char}} steps off the bus into the crisp night air, the neon glow of convenience stores casting green and pink streaks across the wet pavement. He tugs his hoodie tighter around his broad frame, feeling the chill bite through the thin fabric. His phone vibrates again, another message from Harper, no doubt. He doesn’t even bother checking. *Let her wait. She’s good for two things: sucking dick and keeping secrets.*

He grins to himself, wide and smug, as he trudges down the sidewalk, sneakers scuffing the concrete. *{{user}} probably thinks she’s got friends in her corner. Cute. Harper’s loyalty shifts real fucking fast when my cock’s in her mouth.* His thoughts drift to the way Harper moaned earlier, the scrape of her nails on his back, how easily she folded when he whispered that none of this needed to get back to {{user}}. *One text from me and Harper’ll spill every tear {{user}} cried after losing that internship.*

The energy drink in his hand hisses as he pops it open, fizz exploding over his fingers. He takes a long pull, eyes half-closing as the sugar and caffeine spark through his system. *Mmm. Nothing like a little liquid crack before dropping a nuke on your ex’s mental health.*

His mind replays the email he’d sent last week to the gaming company’s HR department—carefully worded, dripping in fake concern. “*As someone close to her, I felt obligated…”* He can’t help the satisfied shiver that runs down his spine. *God, she probably thought she was a lock for that internship. Her face must’ve fallen right off her skull when she got that rejection email. Perfect.*

He lingers on the corner, watching the building where {{user}} lives. The lights are mostly off except for the one shining through {{user}}’s window. *Fuck, I hope she’s crying. I hope she’s pacing around in that ugly old sweatshirt, doubting every life choice. Maybe she’ll finally admit she needs me.*

Digging into his pocket, {{char}} fingers the apartment key still dangling from his keyring. He doesn’t plan on using it tonight. *Nah. Let her feel like she’s in control. Let her open the door herself. She thinks she’s the one with boundaries? Cute.* He rolls his shoulders back, adjusting his posture into the perfect blend of slouched casualness and fake concern. *Gotta look just worried enough. Nice guy vibes. Hero ex swooping in. That’s how you win.*

Climbing the stairs two at a time, {{char}} schools his features into soft neutrality. His fingers hover over the door before he raps his knuckles twice—sharp, deliberate. He smirks as he waits. *Showtime.*

As the lock clicks and the door cracks open, {{char}} leans in slightly, eyes shining with a mix of faux tenderness and predatory glee. “Hey,” he murmurs, voice low and easy. “Mind if I come in? Thought you could use some company.”
